title: National Science Foundation awards (NSF Award Search API)
questions: NSF awards to a university in a year
NSF grants on a research topic (e.g. quantum computing)

manual.how: Search at https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/ (Advanced Search), export the results as CSV, and upload the file; or open the API links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (25 awards per page) and save the JSON.

cache.why: Awards are amended daily; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: NSF award data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). PI and program officer e-mail and phone are dropped.

citation: U.S. National Science Foundation, NSF Award Search ({dataset}), api.nsf.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which dollars? fundsObligatedAmt is what NSF has obligated so far; estimatedTotalAmt is the expected total over the award's life. Default: obligated, said as such.
Which dates? dateStart/dateEnd filter the award date (when NSF made the award); startDate and expDate are the award's period. Default: awards made in the period asked.
